arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Miller argued the lower court erred in requiring a new trial. He said the standard was too broad. Mr. Fahringer argued some errors are so basic they require an automatic new trial. He cited trying a person for conduct that violated no law.

sections.heading: What the justices asked
paragraphs: Justice Scalia asked if the government wants a remand for a new trial.

Justice Stevens asked if the type of violation changes the analysis under Rule 52(b). The rule governs how courts review errors. Justice Ginsburg asked about the effort involved in creating the website before the law passed. Justice Scalia asked if some constitutional violations undermine confidence more than others.
